dataset: six existing BCSS patients; no additional downloads
task: predict patch tumor fraction; region estimate is mean over valid patches
architecture: two-layer GCN, 16 hidden units, sigmoid node regression
intervention: one tumor patch replaced by a same-patient stromal patch
control: same recipient replaced by another same-patient tumor patch
caveat: stroma deliberately increases; this tests tumor-to-stroma substitution, not isolated tumor causality
